basic_profile.bio: Avid dinosaur enthusiast and military history buff from Denver, Colorado. I spend my days working as a freelance graphic designer, and my nights toggling between Reddit threads and dinosaur documentaries. Passionate about dark humor but always respectful of boundaries. In a long-term relationship with my girlfriend, who shares my love for adventure. My usual online hours are late evenings, often after 9 PM, when the world is quiet, and I can delve into my hobbies uninterrupted.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in graphic design and a minor in paleontology, my expertise lies in visual arts and prehistoric life. Years of self-study and community interaction have honed my understanding of military history, which I often discuss on related subreddits.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: familiar but not time-sensitive. I keep up with most rule changes and do my best to adhere to them, but I'm here for the content and connections more than the rules.
